population_coverage.note: Approximate population coverage estimation using HLA frequency heuristics: 75.3% of global population. Run IEDB Population Coverage tool for precise values

cimmsim_submission.tool_description: C-ImmSim uses a position-specific scoring matrix (PSSM) to simulate adaptive immunity. It models B-cell, T-cell, and antibody dynamics over time after repeated antigen injections.

submission_parameters.note: All other parameters can be left at default values

expected_outputs: Immunoglobulin levels (IgM, IgG1, IgG2) over time
B-cell population dynamics (plasma + memory B cells)

interpretation_guide.IgM_spike: Expected after primary injection — marks early immune response
interpretation_guide.IgG_rise: Expected after booster injections — marks memory response
interpretation_guide.low_antigen: Antigen clearance after each injection = healthy response

manual_steps: 2. Paste the vaccine antigen_sequence into 'Antigen Sequence' field
3. Set injection schedule: Day 1, Day 84, Day 168
4. Click 'Run Simulation' — results appear in ~2 minutes
5. Download and attach the IgG/IgM graph to your report
